## Issues

- `09ccf55661` also captured already-staged Mumford JSON/TeX changes through the shared index. The Mumford owner accepted preservation and is recording the contamination; that commit is not a pure Part 01 unit.
- Frozen source nodes 00EU, 00EW, and 00L2 remain unattached and `lean_status: empty`. 00EU’s clauses are proved in Lean; 00EW item (1) packaging and a project-level 00L2 support consumer remain open. Mathlib already supplies `Module.support_eq_zeroLocus`.
- The tracked `.archon-horizon/blueprints/StacksPart01_Preliminaries.json` cache was regenerated at session startup and remains stale/dirty; it was not staged. One pre-existing dangling graph dependency and the global 18-open-task warning remain.
- A parallel LSP probe timed out once; the direct Lean and Horizon checks passed.

## Why I stopped

The objective is partly advanced, not complete. The authored Lean changes are committed and verified, but source attachment and the remaining localization/support frontier are unresolved under the standing protections. The task was deliberately left running.

## Next

Continue with an authorized blueprint bridge, package the remaining 00EW field/subring consequence, and develop a genuine downstream support consumer. Reconcile the generated cache separately from source commits.

## Epistemic Checkpoint

Claim class: proved producers | imported Mathlib boundary | empty/unattached source nodes.  
Frontier before/after: finite localization and reduced minimal-prime infrastructure are now proved; source attachment and support consumption are first unmet.  
Consumer: the minimal-prime kernel chain is internal; the finite quotient result has no external project consumer yet.  
Evidence: targeted/full checks above, named-declaration axiom scans, and hgraph sync/status. `honesty-reviewer: used` — final delta remains honest/partial; the mixed-write-set provenance caveat is recorded.
